verdict.rationale: Make is a workflow automation platform, so durable long-running execution is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents scenarios that pause for days and resume with state intact after worker or platform restarts. Data stores that pass data between runs and scheduled processing of webhook queues are adjacent building blocks, not durable workflow execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state
